in_marathi.name: Dinakar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of the day
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dinakar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dinakar is derived from two Sanskrit words: ‘Dina’ meaning ‘day’ and ‘Kara’ meaning ‘to do’. Thus, Dinakar translates to ‘God of the day’ or ‘Ruler of the day’. It is believed that this name brings the blessings of the sun god Surya, who is responsible for the cycle of days and the passing of time.
